findings.title: retryCount delete condition not scoped to SMS method
findings.body: The second branch of the OR in deleteMany (`retryCount > 1`) has no `method: SMS` filter. This SMS cron will delete any WorkflowReminder with retryCount > 1, including EMAIL and WHATSAPP ones. If other code paths increment retryCount for those methods, the SMS cron will delete their reminders. The condition should be scoped with `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` (and probably `scheduled: false`).

findings.title: Update in catch block can throw and abort the whole cron run
findings.body: The `prisma.workflowReminder.update` inside the catch block is not guarded. If it fails (for example, the reminder was deleted concurrently, or a DB error occurs), the exception propagates out of the loop. The remaining reminders are not processed and the handler returns an error.
